program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((source (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))))
         (src (first (find-color g 2)))
         (dst (first (find-color g 3)))
         (dr (- (first dst) (first src)))
         (dc (- (second dst) (second src))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr))
                   (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
               (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                   (set-cell out nr nc 8)
                   out)))
           g
           (obj-cells source))))
